resources.string: Developer preview build. The production UX of Phase 13 lands on this shell.
No connection — content stays readable, sends queue
Developer preview. No privacy property is verified at this stage.
A phone that is compromised defeats GHOST. What reduces the damage: a dedicated device for high-risk work, and keeping the system updated.
For high-risk profiles use a dedicated device, for example one running GrapheneOS.
Your provider sees that you use Tor. Resistance, not immunity.
Creating the local keys. Nothing leaves this device.
The PIN locks the app when you are away. A fingerprint or face can be used against your will; a PIN in your head cannot. Anyone holding your unlocked phone is what this lock does not stop.
High changes the pacing of traffic and delays some checks. The choice applies from now on: the access you receive next follows this mode.
Write them on paper, keep them offline. Never photograph them, never type them into another app or site. GHOST asks for them only at restore.
Type the words at the positions GHOST asks for. A mistake shows the words again and asks a new check — there is no skip.
GHOST shows one constant message, never its text, never a count, hidden on the lock screen. Listener apps, watches and the system usage records see when it appears.
What this deletes: every message and contact on this phone, your access tokens and unused credits, your identity keys. Copies others hold stay with them; relay copies stay until their time runs out.
Deleted files and keys are as final as this phone storage and its key store allow. Your identity can come back only from the 24 words.
The keys of this phone no longer open the GHOST data. Try again; if it still fails, the data cannot be read anymore: delete it and restore the identity from the 24 words.
Paying from an exchange with identity checks links you to an invoice. The Monero network sees the broadcast moment and your wallet fingerprint. Prefer your own wallet over Tor, at a random moment.
No refund. The exact amount only - a shortfall can be topped up inside the window, nothing extra is returned.
Do not add a lock time. Send unlocked.
You have 24 hours to pay; confirmation can take up to 72 hours. You can pay from another device or later.
Sync pauses while this screen is open and for 20-60 minutes after it closes.
After pasting the address into a wallet, compare its first and last six characters: a keyboard or a clipboard tool can replace it.
The tokens arrive after the network confirms - from minutes to days. GHOST shows one constant message when it happens; nothing else changes here.
No conversations yet. Scan a contact card to start one.
Where did you see this code?
On the phone of the person, in front of me
In a photo, a message, a video call or on another screen
Compare the safety number in person before trusting this contact.
Write it on paper and tell members in person; do not copy it
At most 9 channels per device; at least 2 funders recommended
This link appears once; the person you invite opens it before it expires
Retype the channel\'s five words to authorize this invitation.
The invitation was not created. Check the passphrase and channel state, then try again.
You are already a member of this channel
This channel is protected; type its 5-word passphrase
Wait for a moderator approval; it can take hours
You appear under the same pseudonym as in any earlier channel with this identifier
The photo is re-encoded before it is sent; the original stays in your gallery
The relays see that you stopped the downloads

In high-privacy mode, sends leave after a random delay of up to 10 minutes, the app reads less at each check, and new access becomes usable a few days later. Traffic volume stays visible: GHOST sends no cover traffic.
Every row states what an actor sees at least, what it should not see (a design goal, not yet verified), and the proof from the claims register. A goal becomes a claim only through the register.
blob hashes, a size bucket, the opaque channel namespace, a capability or nullifier, an approximate moment, one Tor circuit
your IP address, your identity, content, channel membership beyond co-occurrence, the social graph, anything about payment
the uniform amount of a payment and its moment, with no sender (Monero), the number of tokens issued, the referral commitment credited, a referrer payout subaddress
the GHOST identity, which token is used where and when, the IP address
the destination, the content, the real sizes, who your correspondents are
the per-channel pseudonym, the content, the time to the minute
your base identity without a reveal, your participation in other channels, your IP address
your base identity, the content, the safety number
your IP address, your channels, unless one was revealed to them
anything above; payment, identity and traffic cannot be linked — today a goal, not a verified property
the amount, the sender, the recipient
An attacker with your unlocked phone
— (out of scope; a compromised phone defeats GHOST, DC-1)
they may message you, for good; the first message hands over the full card
the channel pseudonyms, the join requests, the content
your base identity without a reveal
that you run update checks, the check requests, the release you download
Google, on phones with Google Play services
at an install or update, Play Protect may send Google the app details or the APK, and the developer verification may look the install up (DC-28)
Apps with usage-access or notification access
when a notification appears and the system usage records; the notification carries no content (DC-19, DC-30)
Private preview build. No privacy property of this build is verified yet, and there is no way to report abuse through the app; screenshots are blocked.
Anyone can check an installation on a computer with the public verifier ghost-verify.
Paste the invitation text you received from an existing GHOST user.
Create the first identity of this network (bootstrap)
Activating — this talks to the issuer through Tor and can take a minute.
At least one word does not match. Try again.
Local state: not verified in this process
Send exactly the displayed amount. A shortfall can be topped up inside the payment window.
I have read and acknowledge all five
The payment instructions are unavailable. The purchase may have changed state or the local data may not be unlocked.
You need the 24 words written down when the identity was created. The restore replaces what this device holds.
Type all 24 words in order, separated by spaces.
The words do not match an identity. Check them and try again.
The identity is active on this device again. The conversations rebuild from the relays in the background.
This screen is not part of this build.
Paste the ghost://contact/ link from the person you want to contact.
The card could not be added. Check the link and try again.
A link received through another app can be seen or replaced by that app. Compare the safety number before confirming the contact.
Show this QR in person. A photographed or forwarded code counts as a link; anyone holding your card can message you.
Paste the ghost://channel/ link. GHOST checks it locally and does not request access until you confirm.
Some networks block Tor, and startup can take up to three minutes. Check the connection and the phone clock. GHOST does not fall back to a regular Internet connection.
Before changing phones, keep the 24 words offline. Restore recreates the identity; a protected channel passphrase and some device-local data must be preserved separately.

A compromised phone can read messages. Your Internet provider can see that you use Tor. Channel members can copy received content, and another camera can photograph the screen. GHOST reduces exposure; it does not provide immunity.
The requester does not learn whether you accepted, rejected or blocked. Media in a request never opens.
Compare the 60 digits in person or scan the code. A match confirms that you use the same keys, not the person’s civil identity.
The number becomes available after the first session with this contact is established.
To verify by code, paste the GHOST-SN- payload read by the scanner here.
I compared the 60 digits and they match
Messages are stopped until you decide. Compare the new safety number before accepting the new key as verified.
You can accept without verification, but the contact stays marked unverified and you have no proof that the new key belongs to them.
The code does not match or the action is unavailable for the contact’s state.
The app is up to date.
The update is verified and ready to install.
Version information is old; the app keeps working.
This version is no longer accepted. Update now.
New versions no longer run on this Android version.
No verified version information is available yet.
No update mirror answered the recent checks.
The update check failed. Try again later.
Different versions of the same manifest were received. Do not install GHOST from other sources.
Updates come from the store and do not pass through GHOST verification.
Checks use Tor. An operator controlling both a relay and a mirror can correlate request times.
Android will ask for confirmation. GHOST never installs without your action.
A member revealed their identity to another member
The join request was refused. Check the link, expiry and passphrase, then try again.
The channel could not be created. Check the name, channel limit and relay access, then try again.
Media is unavailable or not fully downloaded. Opening it does not start a new download.
Send the link only through a channel you trust. An app it passes through can see or replace it; in-person QR is preferred.
Use a fresh subaddress from your wallet, never an exchange address. The claim is sent in a later quiet run; an invalid address is refused locally.
The claim was recorded and will be processed automatically.
The claim was refused. Check the address and available credits.
Only states and counts. No ids, addresses, amounts or activity times appear.
Reports stay on this phone. You can read or delete them; this build sends them nowhere.
Enabled accessibility services can read screen content. GHOST applies the protections available on your Android version; a service declaring itself a tool remains allowed for screen-reader users.
Blocking does not notify them or delete copies on their phone; unblocking requires their card again.
The session is rebuilt with the next message. Reset only if the conversation has stopped working.
The action is unavailable for the contact’s current state.
Compare the epoch and code with the other member outside the app. If the epochs differ, compare again later.
The roster is not available yet.
The chosen person will be able to prove that your channel pseudonym belongs to you and will permanently receive your DM card. Other members see that you revealed, not to whom.
I compared the code with this member at the same epoch and it matches
The reveal was sent to the chosen member.
The reveal was not sent. Check the roster and channel state.
Removal is not allowed or is unavailable now.
You reached the 9-channel limit on this device.
Not enough replicas are available to create the channel. Try again after reconnecting.
The cryptographic engine is unavailable. Unlock the app and try again.
The channel name or configuration is invalid.
The phone does not have enough space for a new channel.
